backend/main.mo: Main actor for the Smileup backend, defining data types and state for posts, comments, user profiles, notifications, messages, follows, friendships, and likes, with authorization and blob storage mixins included.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms stored user profiles from the old schema (profilePicture field) to the new schema (profilePhoto field) during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (banner upload, profile photo upload, profile info redesign, etc.) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and notable recent changes.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'Smileup' and mounts the React app via the /src/main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in ThemeProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and QueryClientProvider, showing a loading splash, LandingPage for unauthenticated users, or the full router for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component that renders a circular profile image from an ExternalBlob URL or falls back to a gradient initials placeholder, supporting xs–xl sizes and both legacy and new prop names.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six icon links (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Messages, Create, Profile), active-state highlighting, and a dot indicator on Messages when conversations exist; hidden on the ShortSport route.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component for displaying and submitting comments on a post, supporting both open/onOpenChange and isOpen/onClose prop conventions.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: An editor panel for managing audio tracks, supporting file upload and a mock record toggle, with per-track volume sliders, mute, and remove controls.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: A React panel component for editing canvas design settings including aspect ratio, background color/gradient presets, shape overlays, and decorative elements. Allows users to apply solid colors or gradient presets to the first clip and toggle various shape/color options.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: A canvas-based rendering component that draws the current video frame, background color, text layers, sticker layers, vignette, glitch, and letterbox effects using the HTML5 Canvas API based on the current EditorState.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: A timeline UI component that displays a ruler, playhead, and draggable clip tracks for video/image/blank clips, supporting scrubbing, clip removal, and adding new blank clips.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: A panel component for toggling visual motion graphics effects (confetti, glitch, letterbox, etc.) on the editor state, displaying active effects as tags and available effects as a grid of toggle buttons.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: A panel component for exporting and sharing a video clip, providing title/description metadata fields, a video preview, and a download button that triggers a browser file download of the original clip.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: A panel component for applying and fine-tuning video filter settings (brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, vignette, etc.) via preset buttons and individual sliders, with a reset option.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: A React panel component for adding and managing emoji sticker layers on a video editor, supporting categorized emoji selection, sticker placement with random positioning, and controls for size, rotation, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: A React panel component for adding and editing text layers in a video editor, with controls for font, size, color, bold/italic, alignment, animation, and timing per layer.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: A React panel component that displays a library of video transition effects and allows users to apply specific transitions between consecutive clips in the editor.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, main content outlet, and BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: A dropdown panel listing user notifications (follows, messages) with read/unread state, timestamps, and navigation on click.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Displays a single post with author info, media (image or video), like/comment/share/bookmark actions, optimistic like updates, and intersection-observer-based view tracking.
A dialog modal that shows a grid of the current user's posts as thumbnails, allowing one to be selected for sharing in a message.
frontend/src/components/ShareModal.tsx: A dialog for sharing a post with selected friends via direct message, fetching the friends list and sending messages to all selected recipients.
frontend/src/components/StoriesRow.tsx: A horizontally scrollable stories row showing the current user's story button with a popup and mock story items that open a viewer modal on tap.
frontend/src/components/StoryViewerModal: A full-screen modal component for viewing a single story, displaying the user's avatar, name, handle, and a progress bar, with Escape key and backdrop-click dismissal.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: A sticky top navigation bar showing the Smileup wordmark, notification bell with unread count, search button, and sign-out controls, hiding itself on the '/shortsport' route.
frontend/src/components/TrendingProfiles: A horizontally scrollable section that fetches and displays the top 10 trending creator cards with rank, avatar, follower count, and a profile navigation button, including loading skeletons and an empty state.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, play button, duration badge, like/comment/share/bookmark actions, and a double-tap like animation.
frontend/src/components/YourStoryPopup.t: A small dropdown popup anchored below a trigger element offering two actions—'View My Posts' and 'Create New Post'—that closes on outside clicks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider for ICP, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context and custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, banner images, profile photos, and posts against the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind directives, imports Inter and Syne fonts, and defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes including color tokens, glassmorphism utilities, and gradient text helpers.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces (Post, Comment, User, Story, Message, Conversation) and exports static mock arrays of users, stories, and related data for development/testing purposes.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports utility functions: `cn` for merging Tailwind class names, and formatters for large numbers, time durations, and relative timestamps.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, mounting it to the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating new posts supporting text, image, and video types, with file selection, media preview, upload progress tracking, and submission via the `useCreatePost` mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page that manages editor state (clips, text layers, stickers, audio, filters, effects) and renders a panel-based UI with tools for trimming, filters, effects, stickers, design, and export.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore/search page that displays posts and users with debounced search input, tab switching between post and user results, and navigation to user profiles.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Main social feed page that displays stories, trending profiles, and a chronologically sorted list of posts with loading skeletons, error, and empty states. Supports opening a comments sheet for individual posts.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Unauthenticated landing page for Smileup that shows a branded login button using Internet Identity and highlights key app features (posts, videos, connect).
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging page with a conversation list sidebar and a message thread view, supporting sending messages, marking them read, and starting new chats from friends/following lists.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper page that extracts a principalId URL param and renders MessagesPage with that principal pre-selected as the initial conversation.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing banner, avatar, bio, follower/following counts, and a grid of the user's posts or liked posts, with inline editing and image upload support.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical short-video feed page with per-video play/pause, mute, like, comment, share, auto-scroll, and follow/unfollow functionality.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: React page component that displays a user's public profile (by principal or handle), showing their avatar, banner, stats, posts grid, and follow/friend action buttons with real-time state from backend queries.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines the TanStack Router route tree for the frontend, mapping URL paths to page components including feed, explore, profile, messages, and user profile routes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, typography/container-query plugins, custom fonts, border radii, and box shadows for the app's dark design system.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file that records the current build version, feature history, architectural notes, and known issues for the social app's profile page upgrade work.
